evidence: Changes orphan management and transaction download in src/node/txorphanage.{cpp,h} and src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp.
rationale: Prevents memory exhaustion attacks where peers bypass orphan limits to consume excessive memory and spike CPU. Standard-weight transactions with small witness elements consume 11.1MB of memory against ~400k weight units (a 28x discrepancy), allowing peers to hold witness-heavy orphans that trigger severe transient memory and CPU spikes in 1P1C processing.
